description: This file defines the VoiceWakeManager class which manages voice wake-up functionality in an Android app. It handles speech recognition, trigger words, starting/stopping listening, and processing recognized speech commands.

classes.name: VoiceWakeManager
classes.description: Manages voice recognition lifecycle, trigger words, and command processing.

methods.name: setTriggerWords
methods.description: Sets the list of trigger words for wake-up detection.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the listening process, initializing speech recognizer.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops listening and clears the recognizer.

methods.name: startListeningInternal
methods.description: Internal method that starts the speech recognition listening process.

methods.name: scheduleRestart
methods.description: Schedules a restart of listening after a delay.

methods.name: handleTranscription
methods.description: Processes recognized text, extracts commands, and triggers onCommand if matched.
